heading: 1.4 Descriptive Statistics
text: Calculate mean standard deviation BART score helmet beseball cap groups:Q3a mean standard deviation cap condition?Q3b mean standard deviation helmet condition?
code:
stats <- data %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(meanBART = mean(BART),
            sdBART = sd = BART)

heading: 1.5 Histogram
text: remaining part chapter, focus exploring interpreting plots rather understanding code. learn ggplot2 code (data visualisation) later term. now just focus adding variable names producing basic plots.Create histogram, change word NULL1 want show x-axis (tip: name dependent variable) NULL2 independent variable:
code:
ggplot(data, aes(x = NULL1, fill =NUll2)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, colour = "black")

heading: 1.5.1 Create Separate Histograms
text: can use facet_wrap() function separate histograms condition:
code:
ggplot(data, aes(x = NULL1, fill =NUll2)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ condition)

heading: 1.6 Density Plot
text: Create density plot, need change NULL1 NULL2 dependent variable:Q4a looking density plot, condition (cap helmet) greater density higher risk taking scores?Q4b looking density plot, condition (cap helmet) greater density lower risk taking scores?
code:
ggplot(data, aes(x = NULL1, fill = NULL2)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2)

heading: 1.7 Box Plot
text: Create box plot (note change x y axis one)…Look back mean standard deviations questions 1() 1(b). match box plots show?
code:
ggplot(data, aes(x = NULL2, y = NULL1)) +
  geom_boxplot()

heading: 1.8 Violin Plot
text: Create box plot…Q5 Based descriptive statistics plots produced workshop, answer research question? statistics plots help support answer?
code:
ggplot(data, aes(x = NULL2, y = NULL1)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2)
